term: immutable (ST I q.9; Lean parameter `Immutable` of `GodIsImmutable`)
definition: `Immutable g`: g is altogether immutable in the sense of ST I q.9 a.1: in potency in no respect, so without any capacity for change, not merely not changing now. In stage 2 group 1 (#198) the predicate is opaque: CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-CLASSICAL-ATTRIBUTES accepts any predicate under this name, so nothing proved there depends on its content.
note: Stage 2 group 2 (#199) fixes the reading in Lean as `IsImmutable` (in potency in no respect, ST I q.9 a.1).
